title: Velvet
Hour
hero.sub: A live-band soul and funk revue built to get the whole room dancing. Two nights at The Anthem, a twelve-piece band, and a show where the crowd is part of the act.

about.heading: Two hours where the crowd is part of the show
paragraphs: Rio Delacroix does not let up. From the first horn hit to the last encore, every song is one you know by the second chorus, and every set change turns the stage into a new scene: the velvet rope, the funk breakdown, the slow jam, the mirror ball.

June Halloway opens the night, then comes back mid-set for a duet. The Dance Cam roams the floor and the balcony and puts you on the big screen. The finale sends confetti over the whole room, not just the front rows. Come ready to dance; you will not be watching from the outside.

speakers.heading: Lineup
speakers.intro: One headliner, one opener who comes back for more, a band built for stamina, and two DJs to keep the floor warm.

items.name: Rio Delacroix
items.bio: Singer, dancer and bandleader-in-chief. Rio runs a two-hour revue without a single sit-down moment, and the encore is never the same twice.

tickets.heading: Tickets
tickets.intro: Every ticket covers both nights. Pick a column to choose a ticket. Hover or tap a row to see exactly what it covers.

rows.label: Reserved seat
rows.detail: [PLACEHOLDER] A numbered balcony seat, the same seat both nights. Soundcheck VIP gets a balcony box seat on top of floor access.

rows.label: Guaranteed front rail
rows.detail: A spot at the rail both nights, held until the Velvet Rope scene starts.

rows.label: Merch
rows.detail: Picked up at the merch desk either night. Front Rail gets the tour tee. Soundcheck VIP gets the tee and a numbered screen-printed poster.

tickets.footnote: [PLACEHOLDER] Prices include fees. Tickets can be transferred until 48 hours before Night 1.

venue.heading: Getting there
venue.intro: The Anthem sits on The Wharf in Southwest DC. Metro is the easiest way in; plan your ride home before the encore.

items.title: Address
items.body: [PLACEHOLDER] The Anthem, 901 Wharf St SW, Washington, DC 20024.

items.title: Metro
items.body: [PLACEHOLDER] Green Line to Waterfront station, then about a 10 minute walk to The Wharf. L'Enfant Plaza serves more lines and is a slightly longer walk. Check the last train time before you stay for the afterparty.

items.title: Rideshare
items.body: [PLACEHOLDER] Use the marked drop-off and pickup zone on Maine Ave SW. After the show, walk to the zone before you book; the streets right outside the doors back up fast.

items.title: Bag policy
items.body: [PLACEHOLDER] Clear bags or a small clutch only. No backpacks. Every bag is checked at the door.

items.title: ID
items.body: [PLACEHOLDER] Bring a photo ID. You need it for a drinks wristband, and Front Rail and Soundcheck VIP check-in matches the ID to the name on the ticket.

items.title: Accessibility
items.body: [PLACEHOLDER] Step-free entry, accessible balcony seating and a raised viewing platform beside the dance floor. Contact the box office before the show to arrange a spot or a companion seat.

registration.confirmation: [PLACEHOLDER] Your tickets arrive by email two weeks before Night 1. Bring the QR code and a photo ID. Dance Floor holders are entered in each night's front rail draw when they scan in.

items.q: How does the front rail lottery work?
items.a: Every Dance Floor ticket gets one draw per night. Scan in by 6:55 PM and you are entered automatically. The draw happens at 7:00 PM; winners get a text and a rail wristband and head to the front before the opener. Friday's draw does not carry over, so Saturday is a fresh chance.

items.q: Does the Dance Cam record anything?
items.a: No. The Dance Cam is a live feed to the big screen and nothing else. It is not recorded, saved or streamed. If you would rather not be on screen, cross your arms in an X and the operator moves on.

items.q: Do I need a ticket for each night?
items.a: No. Every ticket covers both Friday and Saturday. Night 2 has a different DJ and one surprise guest slot, so it is worth coming back.
Doors are at 6:30 PM and the Dance Cam warm-up starts at 7:15 PM. Rio Delacroix is on stage around 9:30 PM. Front Rail and Soundcheck VIP can come in from 6:00 PM.

items.q: Will I get confetti in the balcony?
items.a: Yes. The finale cannons are aimed at the whole room, balcony included.
No. Velvet, sequins, platforms and gold are all welcome, and they do tend to catch the Dance Cam's eye.

items.q: Can I bring a bag or a camera?
items.a: [PLACEHOLDER] Clear bags and small clutches only. Phones are fine. Professional cameras with detachable lenses are not. See Getting there for the full bag policy.
[PLACEHOLDER] All ages. Under 16s need to be with an adult. You need to be 21 with ID to buy alcohol.
